# form.addSensorField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.4</span></div>

Add a sensor field to the current form.

```lua
form.addSensorField(line, rect, getValue, setValue[, filterValue])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current value |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on value change |
| `filterValue` | function | optional | the function which will filter values |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addSensorField(line, nil, function() return switch end, function(newValue) switch = newValue end)
```

## Used in

- [tool-form](../../examples/official/tool-form.md)
